hypothesis: High-purity history-only anonymous batter identity recovery lets the unused official TrackMan rows estimate pitcher-by-batter-hand/count and pitcher-by-batter/count pitch selection. These target-free matchup profiles can improve the deployable fine-pitch selector beyond pitcher/count profiles alone.

source_protocol.route: R rows with an exactly linked historical auto pitch label for diagnostics
source_protocol.identity_cutoff: exactly linked R games with season strictly before target year
source_protocol.trackman_cutoff: official TrackMan rows with season strictly before target year
source_protocol.ranking: minimize worst source log-loss, then mean log-loss, then maximize minimum top-1 improvement, then lexical id
source_protocol.on_fail: Close without reading 2022+ selector or control metrics.
source_protocol.on_pass: Freeze one selector recipe before any downstream control-success experiment.
